title: qubex-config manifest
description: Declares which layout version a qubex-config tree follows. Lives at <root>/qubex-config.json. 1.0 is the per-chip layout used before qubex 1.5; 2.0 is the shared layout keyed by system_id.

converted_from.description: Layout the tree was converted from, when it was converted by a script.

generated_by.description: Tool and version that wrote this file.
